create_sequence: create a Sequence object initialized with token IDs and sampling parameters
test_sequence_is_finished: test the Sequence class is_finished property that checks if status equals FINISHED
build_sequence_clone_spec: build a cloned Sequence with identical state for speculative decoding using clone_spec
run_sequence_append_token: run sequence.append_token to append a token ID and update last_token and num_tokens
review_sequence_properties: review the Sequence class properties including num_completion_tokens, prompt_token_ids, and completion_token_ids
